newsitem.title: USA: CBOT August soymeal up $10/ton limit as funds buy.
newsitem.headline: CBOT August soymeal up $10/ton limit as funds buy.

text.p: CBOT August soymeal futures rose the $10 per ton limit on Wednesday on aggressive fund and commercial buying amid rumors of export business, traders said.
Old crop soybean futures were also near the 30-cent per bushel upper limit.

Traders pointed to persistent rumors of soymeal and soybean export sales to China. Asian traders said Chinese companies have been buying significant quantities of U.S. soybeans and soymeal since early July as world prices slumped.
Limitless July also posted strong gains. No deliveries have been posted yet and none are expected.
At 1216 CDT, soymeal was up $10.30 to $4.60 per ton with August up $10.00 at $243.80. Soybeans were up 28 to 10-3/4 cents per bushel with August up 28 at $7.50.
